title: Picture VERY misleading.
text: Picture VERY misleading.. The picture featured with item is a MUCH lighter shade of wood than the mirror actually is. The product itself is nice and the quality of the wood is good, but this is not what we were expecting. It does not match any of our other furniture. Very disappointed with the misleading picture.

product_metadata.title: Coastal Collection SFM-2433 San Remo Series Black Walnut with Chestnut Finish Framed Mirror, 24-Inch-by-33-Inch
features: 1-Inch beveled mirror and Chestnut finish showcase the intricate design
Custom designed packaging for secure shipment to your home
description: Experience the intricate design of the San Remo series in Black Walnut. This series is offered in our classic Chestnut finish. San Remo also features full overlay square flat panel styling on a mitered frame. Proudly made in the USA, the San Remo Series offers Vanities, Medicine Cabinets, Framed Mirrors, Side Cabinets, and Tall Linens. Let the San Remo series create the complete ensemble for your bathroom project. San Remo vanities with drawers feature real wood dovetail drawers, 0.5-Inch thick plywood side panels, solid wood front frames, and 6 way adjustable concealed hinges. Tall linens feature adjustable shelves and maple finished interiors. Medicine cabinets can be recess or surface mount for easy installation. Framed mirrors and matching side cabinets are the perfect complement. This framed mirror measures 24-Inch-Wide-By-33-Inch-Tall.
